content: riverqueue/river latest v0.43.0 (Aug 2026), Postgres+pgx v5 native job queue with generic river.Worker[T]/JobArgs, SKIP LOCKED based claiming, OTel hooks in v0.41+. Only official driver is riverpgxv5 (pgx v5 pool); a database/sql driver (riverdatabasesql) exists for compat. No MySQL/SQLite support - Postgres only.
